Abilities.Name: AP Dice Bonus
Abilities.Effect: Once per Group, Asset, or Dropsite activation, or during the Repair step of the End Phase, after you roll any dice, you can add 1 to the result of one of those dice. This Ability cannot be used on D3s or dice results of a 1, and dice modified by this ability cannot score criticals.

Abilities.Name: Brace for Impact
Abilities.Effect: After you roll for Crippling Effects, re-roll the Crippling Effect roll.

Abilities.Name: Contain Reactor
Abilities.Effect: When a player would roll for Explosion, instead of rolling, make the result of an Explosion roll (for you or your opponent) a 2.

Abilities.Name: Time to Target
Abilities.Effect: After moving a Wing of your Fighters or Bombers, you may move that Wing (or the Wing it combined into) a second time with a Thrust of 6" in any direction. The Wing cannot divide into smaller Wings or form/be formed into larger Wings due to this additional movement.
